ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $BC= \frac{1}{2} AB$, and $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$. If $DB=1$, what is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because BC= \frac{1}{2} AB$,\\
$\therefore AC=AB+BC= \frac{3}{2}AB$,\\
$\because D$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
$\therefore CD= \frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times \frac{3}{2}AB=\frac{3}{4}AB$,\\
$\therefore DB=CD-BC= \frac{3}{4}AB-\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{4}AB$,\\
which means $\frac{1}{4}AB=1$,\\
$\therefore AB=\boxed{4}$.
